text_block_list.text: But whatever I achieved is thanks to the Umamusume! They're the reason why I push myself.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Like the ones I ran with today. They made me so emotional! Like, did you see—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, she goes on telling me how charming the other racers were today.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I guess I didn't have the heart to be first today…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I need to get my act together and work harder to do my oshis proud!
